name: Document extraction with field-level eval
problem: Extract fields from synthetic invoices/bank statements; measure accuracy per field and per template, route low confidence to review.
limits: Synthetic financial records only, with original rendered templates and seeded blur/rotation. Real Tesseract OCR runs on every image. No LLM or real invoice data is used. Accuracy is exact field equality against generated ground truth. Per-field/per-template table: evidence/field-table.md; confidence tradeoff: evidence/review-curve.json and evidence/tradeoff.svg. Confidence is uncalibrated OCR confidence; no auto-approved documents yields null accuracy rather than fabricated success. Install the system tesseract executable before make setup (brew install tesseract on macOS or apt-get install tesseract-ocr on Linux).
next: Evaluate more layouts, calibrate confidence, and add table/line-item extraction.
